points.en: Inflation: Sustained increase in general price level, leading to fall in purchasing power.
points.hi: Inflation: Sustained increase in general price level, leading to fall in purchasing power.

points.en: Deflation: Sustained decrease in general price level.
points.hi: Deflation: Sustained decrease in general price level.

points.en: Disinflation: Slowing down of the rate of inflation.
points.hi: Disinflation: Slowing down of the rate of inflation.

points.en: Reflation: Deliberate action to increase price level to combat deflation.
points.hi: Reflation: Deliberate action to increase price level to combat deflation.

points.en: Hyperinflation: Extremely high, out-of-control inflation (often >50% per month).
points.hi: Hyperinflation: Extremely high, out-of-control inflation (often >50% per month).

explanation.en: Deflation is a drop in prices; Disinflation is a drop in the rate of price rise; Reflation is a policy-driven rise in prices.
explanation.hi: Deflation is a drop in prices; Disinflation is a drop in the rate of price rise; Reflation is a policy-driven rise in prices.

answer.en: A situation characterized by stagnant economic growth, high unemployment, and high inflation.
answer.hi: A situation characterized by stagnant economic growth, high unemployment, and high inflation.

correction.en: Inflation benefits debtors and borrowers, while it hurts creditors and fixed-income earners.
correction.hi: Inflation benefits debtors and borrowers, while it hurts creditors and fixed-income earners.

fiveFacts.en: Inflation reduces the real value of money.
fiveFacts.hi: Inflation reduces the real value of money.

fiveFacts.en: CPI (Consumer Price Index) is the primary measure for retail inflation in India.
fiveFacts.hi: CPI (Consumer Price Index) is the primary measure for retail inflation in India.

fiveFacts.en: WPI (Wholesale Price Index) measures price changes at the wholesale level.
fiveFacts.hi: WPI (Wholesale Price Index) measures price changes at the wholesale level.

fiveFacts.en: Core inflation excludes volatile items like food and fuel.
fiveFacts.hi: Core inflation excludes volatile items like food and fuel.

fiveFacts.en: Headline inflation includes all items in the basket.
fiveFacts.hi: Headline inflation includes all items in the basket.

threeTraps.en: Assuming WPI is the sole indicator for RBI's monetary policy.
threeTraps.hi: Assuming WPI is the sole indicator for RBI's monetary policy.

threeTraps.en: Ignoring the impact of base effects on year-on-year inflation data.
